findings.evidence: The harmless exact wrapper returned rc0 but perf -o output began with `# started on Thu Oct 8 ...` and a blank line. protocol_0970_v2.parse_perf_sidecar currently rejects the comment as malformed. Filtering only blank/comment lines allowed the same six frozen event rows to parse, confirming a narrow parser defect.
findings.required_correction: Fresh protocol/runner/reducer/helper/plan/diagnostic seal must ignore only blank lines and documented lines whose first nonspace character is `#`, while retaining strict exact event-row, not-counted, duplicate, and malformed-row rejection. Add the observed header to self-test and rerun the exact wrapper parser regression before root GO.
